{{short description|Armenian-Russian scientist}}
'''Nikolay Sergeyevich Enikolopov''' ('''Enikolopyan''') ({{langx|ru|Николай Сергеевич Ениколопов (Ениколопян)}}; March 13, 1924, [[Stepanakert]] – January 22, 1993, [[Berlin]]) was an Armenian-Russian scientist, [[Doktor nauk|Doctor]] of [[Chemistry]], professor, academic of [[Russian Academy of Sciences]],<ref>Armenian Concise Encyclopaedia, ed. by [[Konstantin Khudaverdyan]], Vol. 2, p. 98</ref> director of the ''Institute of Synthetic polymers'' (Currently ''Nikolay Enikolopov Institute of Synthetic Polymers''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ispm.ru/History.html|title=History|publisher=Yenikolopov Institute of Synthetic Polymers|language=Russian|accessdate=2009-04-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090623222921/http://www.ispm.ru/History.html|archive-date=2009-06-23|url-status=dead}}</ref>) of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. In 1980 he was awarded by the [[Lenin Prize]].

In 1945 Enikolopov graduated from the [[Yerevan Polytechnic Institute]]. Since 1946 he worked at the Moscow [[Institute of Chemical Physics]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], headed the laboratory of [[polymer]]s. In 1982-1993 he headed also a department at the [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ениколопов, Николай Сергеевич {{!}} Кто такой Ениколопов, Николай Сергеевич? |url=https://dic.academic.ru/dic.nsf/enc_biography/26165/%D0%95%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%B2 |access-date=2023-06-06 |website=Словари и энциклопедии на Академике |language=ru}}</ref>

On January 22, 1993, he died in Heidelberg, Germany. He was buried at [[Novodevichy Cemetery]] in Moscow. In 1998, by Resolution No. 235 of the Presidium of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] dated June 16, 1998, the Institute was named after Academician Enikolopov.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Московские могилы. Ениколопов Н.С. |url=http://moscow-tombs.ru/1993/enikolopov_ns.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130518065240/http://moscow-tombs.ru/1993/enikolopov_ns.htm |archive-date=2013-05-18 |access-date=2026-06-19 |website=moscow-tombs.ru}}</ref>
